The Portal

Two portals, one island. The blue one makes memes. The green one tells you how a face drawn in MS Paint ended up on Canton.

2008. Artist Carlos Ramirez (Whynne) draws a crude MS Paint grin in a webcomic poking fun at trolling culture on 4chan. The grin escapes. It becomes the universal reply to anyone taking the internet too seriously.

2025–2026. The face gets tokenized — the original TROLLWORLD at trollface.io plants it on Solana. Meanwhile, on Canton Network, a whole meme district grows up: bears, dogs, lizards, wizard kitties — and a laughing round troll called $LOL.

Now. This island is the Canton edition of that world: same map, same hotspots, same deadpan — rebuilt with Canton's own troll, his 9 faces and his 9 outfits. trolololol.

History bit is real: Trollface, Carlos Ramirez, 2008, MS Paint, 4chan. The Canton island is a fan-made community tribute — it does not claim the original Trollface IP license held by the Solana project.
